summary:
For someone in Micronesia Federated States Of, the three needs areas with the largest gaps are: mobility (0.28), work (0.52), communications (0.57).
The three strongest areas are: education (0.85), water (0.75), safety (0.75).
Personal-agent suggestions: focus community-building energy on weakest categories; leverage strongest categories as sources of economic value to bring to the community.
